notes.title: Capcom Fighting Collection 2 - Free Title Update Coming Aug 7!
notes.notes:
Prepare to take this fight to the MAX with a free title update for Capcom Fighting Collection 2 on August 7th! 

[previewyoutube=hpkKhAJoFz4;full][/previewyoutube]

1. Unlock Maki, Yun, Eagle and Ingrid for Street Fighter Alpha 3 UPPER in EX settings. New artwork for these characters will also be added to the gallery! Also, additional modes Mazi, Saikyo, and Classic can be selected on the character select screen. These modes can be enabled in EX settings.

2. Plasma Combo routes can now be displayed in training mode in Plasma Sword: Nightmare of Bilstein.
 
3. Two new remix tracks by CAP-JAMS from the Capcom Sound Team will be added!
- Esaka (Japan Stage) - Arranged by CAP-JAMS
- Londo Stage - Arranged by CAP-JAMS

4. New artwork will be added to the Capcom Fighting Collection 2 gallery.

More details about the latest update:
https://www.capcom-games.com/cfc2/en-us/patch/

Titles:
Capcom vs. SNK: Millennium Fight 2000 Pro
Capcom vs. SNK 2: Mark of the Millennium 2001
Capcom Fighting Evolution
Street Fighter Alpha 3 UPPER
Project Justice
Power Stone
Power Stone 2
Plasma Sword: Nightmare of Bilstein
 
All games will feature online play and rollback netcode!
